title: key_persistence.py: TrustStorePersistence.save() missing file permission restriction
description: TrustStorePersistence.save() uses atomic write but doesn't set restrictive permissions on trust_store.json. FileKeyStore._write_slot() properly sets 0600 via os.chmod() before rename, but TrustStorePersistence doesn't. Trust entries may contain sensitive peer pubkeys and trust levels. Add os.chmod(tmp_path, stat.S_IRUSR | stat.S_IWUSR) before os.replace() in save().
